summary.text: Aletheia McCaskill is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 44B and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She and fellow incumbent Sheila Ruth face Republican Domonic Martin for the district's two seats.
She owns and directs the child care business Tender Tots and serves on the Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Aletheia McCaskill was born in Baltimore and graduated from Carver Vo-Tech High School in 1989.
She earned a B.S. in information systems from Villa Julie College in 1994 and, in 2021, a B.S. in early elementary and early childhood education from Notre Dame of Maryland University.

McCaskill worked as a computer operator at Johns Hopkins Bayview Medical Center and as a computer programmer for the Department of Economic and Employment Development, and she has owned and directed Tender Tots since 1998.
She is also vice president of the Early Learning Division of SEIU Local 500.
McCaskill assumed office on January 11, 2023, succeeding Pat Young, according to Ballotpedia.
She is a member of the Appropriations Committee, according to the General Assembly website.
